points.quote: `IDisposable` is the base contract. `dispose()` accepts one disposable or an iterable of them. `Event.on…` subscriptions return an `IDisposable`, so a listener's lifetime is whatever holds its handle.
an owner extends it and calls `this._register(x)`. Everything registered is disposed together with the owner.
`DisposableStore`: a bag of disposables. ... `toDisposable(fn)` and `combinedDisposable(...)`: wrap cleanup logic, or group several disposables into one.
`MutableDisposable`: holds one value. Assigning a new value disposes the old one, and disposing the holder disposes the current value.
`ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite()` (`src/vs/base/test/common/utils.ts:53`) installs a tracker in `setup`. In `teardown`, a passing test fails with "There are N undisposed disposables!"
